decision.discovery: At least two independent natural acquisition episodes contain identified not-near failure, successful navigation without resolving target evidence, and another same-target not-near failure.
decision.mechanism: Replay both arms on the first two supporting acquisition tasks, once each. Require fewer retries without new target evidence, with no reduction in summed success or progress. This outcome-selected acquisition screen is not held-out evidence.
decision.proxy_and_finalist: Unchanged Phase-5 semantic task-first Gate, plus paired task-success non-inferiority LCB >= -0.05.
decision.shadow: Positive but underpowered candidates may be tested on finalist, but cannot be promoted through a failed proxy.
decision.audit: Open audit only after proxy and finalist pass. Preserve audit failures and do not tune against them.
decision.no_candidate: Stop after the registered acquisition budget; do not insert a human candidate.
decision.local_endpoints: Mechanism diagnostics only: failed-target retry without new evidence, evidence recovery, invalid actions, guard blocks, steps, and per-purpose cost. No local endpoint substitutes for the task gate.

parallelism.assignment: Fixed task-level endpoint index in dataset manifest; both arms and all seeds of each task stay on the same endpoint.
parallelism.arm_order: Counterbalance by numeric task index plus rollout seed.
parallelism.deviation: This bounded diagnostic registers two endpoint blocks, unlike the single-host controlled main protocol; do not treat it as an official controlled artifact.
